data.description:
## What
Update `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` to call `review-complexity-classifier.sh` via subprocess instead of importing `classify_tier` from `classifier.py`.

## Changes
1. Remove `from dso_ci_review.classifier import classify_tier` import (line 30)
2. Add subprocess call at runner.py line ~474 (Step 1: classify tier):
   - Locate `review-complexity-classifier.sh` relative to `_PLUGIN_ROOT` (mirrors how `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` resolves `_PLUGIN_ROOT`)
   - Call via `subprocess.run(["bash", str(classifier_script)], input=diff_text, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)`
   - Parse stdout as JSON to get classification dict
   - On non-zero exit or JSON parse error: log warning and return fallback classification `{"selected_tier": "standard"}`
3. The `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` env var is the primary resolution path; fallback to `__file__`-relative resolution

## Why
Makes Task A's RED test pass. Completes the Python→bash classifier migration in runner.py.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py (modify — remove import, add subprocess call ~line 474)

## Acceptance Criteria
- runner.py does not import from dso_ci_review.classifier
- runner.py calls subprocess.run with review-complexity-classifier.sh
- test_runner_uses_bash_classifier passes
- make lint passes
- make format-check passes

## Testing Mode
GREEN — makes task 6430-6a72 RED test pass

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py (modify)
